issues.description: Developer.attend(course:) is specified (and stubbed in the template) to accept an optional `Course?` so learners can use optional binding to handle `nil`, but the solution implements `attend(course:)` with a non-optional `Course` parameter. This contradicts the required API and prevents passing `nil` as intended by the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution signature to `func attend(course: Course?)` and unwrap with optional binding (e.g., `guard let course = course else { return }`) before checking the course name and updating `monthsOfSwiftExperience`. Alternatively, if non-optional is desired, update the problem statement and template to remove the optional/nil handling requirement.
